content.value_statement: Internal updates often need consistent structure, clear audience focus, and concise language. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft common workplace messages in familiar formats.
actual_capabilities: Identifies whether a request is a 3P update, newsletter, FAQ response, status report, leadership update, project update, or incident report.
Guides the assistant to select the matching internal communication format before drafting.
Prompts the assistant to ask for clarification when the requested format is unclear.
Applies a concise workplace style for internal announcements and updates.
Supports adapting a draft for different internal audiences and message types.
limitations: This package references example guideline files that are not included.
It does not verify company facts, dates, metrics, owners, or incident details.
It cannot replace legal, HR, or executive approval for sensitive announcements.
It needs user-provided context for audience, purpose, timeline, and desired tone.

use_cases.title: Weekly Team Update
use_cases.description: Team leads can turn project notes into a concise 3P update for a recurring team meeting.

use_cases.title: Executive Brief
use_cases.description: Program managers can summarize progress, risks, decisions, and asks for senior leaders.

use_cases.title: Employee FAQ Response
use_cases.description: People teams can draft clear responses to recurring employee questions after a policy or process change.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Status Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a routine project update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a status report for [team or project]. Audience: [audience]. Include progress, current risks, next steps, and open questions. Use a concise internal tone.

prompt_templates.title: Create a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured prompt for progress, plans, and problems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 3P update from these notes: [notes]. Separate progress, plans, and problems. Highlight blockers and owners where available.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Leadership Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for revising an existing draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this draft for leadership: [draft]. Make it concise, decision-focused, and clear about risks, tradeoffs, and requested actions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Incident Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for sensitive operational communication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an internal incident report using these confirmed facts: [facts]. Include impact, timeline, mitigation, owner, follow-up actions, and unknowns.

output_examples.input: Draft a weekly 3P update from notes about launch testing.
output: Progress: Launch testing completed for the main user flows, with two defects fixed before release review.
Plans: The team will run final regression checks and prepare the release readiness summary.
Problems: Payment retry testing remains blocked pending access to the staging provider account.

output_examples.input: Rewrite a project note for senior leadership.
output_examples.output: The project remains on track for the planned milestone. The main risk is delayed partner feedback, which could affect final approval timing. The team recommends confirming the review owner by Friday.

output_examples.input: Create an FAQ answer about a new internal process.
output_examples.output: Employees should submit requests through the new intake form starting Monday. Existing requests will stay in the current queue. Managers can contact the operations team for urgent exceptions.

best_practices: Provide audience, purpose, timeline, owner, and desired decision before asking for a draft.
Include source notes or approved facts so the output does not invent details.
Review sensitive messages with appropriate leaders before sending.
anti_patterns: Ask the skill to invent metrics, dates, owners, or commitments.
Use the same message for executives, teams, and company-wide audiences without adaptation.
Publish incident, HR, or legal communications without human review.

faq.question: What types of communication does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Can it write messages for executives?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the decision, risks, metrics, and requested action so the draft stays focused for leaders.

faq.question: Does it include company-specific templates?
faq.answer: The skill references company-style guideline files, but those example files are not included in this package.

faq.question: Can it verify facts before sending?
faq.answer: No. Users must supply and verify facts, dates, metrics, owners, and approvals before publishing.

faq.question: Can it help with incident communications?
faq.answer: Yes. Use confirmed facts only, then review the draft with operational, legal, or communications owners.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
